leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Create a structural directive that receives a TemplateRef and ViewContainerRef via constructor injection
Implement the @Input setter that triggers a permission check and calls createEmbeddedView() or clear() on the ViewContainerRef
Inject AuthService using the inject() function inside the directive and read the current user's permission array
Support an optional fallback template (@Input as 'appHasPermissionElse') that renders when the permission check fails
Add OR logic support so *hasPermission="['admin','superuser']" shows the element if the user has either role
Ensure the directive re-evaluates when the user's permission set changes (e.g., after assuming a role) by subscribing to an auth observable
Test the directive with a mock AuthService and verify that the template is rendered or cleared based on the permission state
